evidence.title: Saving 100 terabytes of memory by optimizing 1.1.1.1's DNS cache

summary: Cloudflare has significantly reduced memory usage for its 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver by optimizing its caching mechanism. The improvement frees up 100 terabytes of memory while maintaining performance.
title: Cloudflare Optimizes 1.1.1.1 DNS Cache, Saving 100 Terabytes of Memory
